title: Domain.com Hosting Review 2026: Plans, Renewal Prices and the Network Solutions Move
excerpt: Domain.com hosting costs $35.88 for the first year and about three times that to renew. Here is the three-year cost, what we could not verify, and the Network Solutions move.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Domain.com Hosting Review 2026: Prices and Renewals
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Domain.com hosting review for 2026: plan prices and three-year cost, renewals three times higher, the 99% uptime guarantee and the move to Network Solutions.
meta.rl_answer: Domain.com hosting is cheap in year one and about three times dearer at renewal. It lists a 99% uptime guarantee, we found no independent speed test, and Domain.com is becoming Network Solutions.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Domain.com good for hosting? | It is simple to start. Renewal is about three times the first-year price, and we found no independent speed test.
How much does Domain.com hosting cost? | Starter is $35.88 for the first year and $105.99 a year at renewal. Essential is $59.88 then $184.99. Premium is $83.88 then $224.99.
Is Domain.com the same as Network Solutions? | Domain.com is becoming Network Solutions, according to HowToHosting. Both sit under Newfold Digital.
What is the Domain.com uptime guarantee? | Its plan page lists 99%, which allows about 7 hours of downtime a month.
Does Domain.com have a free domain? | Essential and Premium include a free domain and SSL for 1 year.
Does Domain.com have an AI website builder? | HostAdvice reports one on all plans. Our read of the hosting page did not list one.
Does Domain.com have phone support? | TechRadar notes phone support. Domain.com's page lists 24/7 chat.
Does Domain.com include domain privacy? | HostAdvice says privacy is on by default. TechRadar says free domain privacy is not included. Check the checkout.
Does Domain.com have hidden fees? | Reviewers warn about upselling and steep renewals. Renewal rates show only at checkout in one review.
How steep is the Domain.com renewal price? | Starter renews at 3.0 times the first-year price, Essential at 3.1 times and Premium at 2.7 times.
Is Domain.com good for WordPress? | We found no independent WordPress test. Compare hosts with published speed results.
Who should avoid Domain.com? | Anyone who plans to stay for years, wants proven speed or wants a strong uptime promise.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Starter is $35.88 for the first year and renews at $105.99, about three times higher.
Domain.com lists a 99% uptime guarantee, about 7 hours of downtime a month.
We found no independent speed or uptime test with a stated method.
Domain.com is becoming Network Solutions, per HowToHosting.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Domain.com hosting is a simple, cheap first year and an expensive third. We found no independent speed test, the uptime promise is 99%, and the product is moving to Network Solutions. Compare hosts with published results first.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You already buy domains at Domain.com and want a very simple first site.
You will move hosts after year one.

meta.rl_r_skip:

meta.rl_r_best: A very simple first site for a short time
meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our websites with Domain.com, so this review rests on published data
Pricing and terms | Domain.com's web hosting page, read on 15 November 2026: plans, renewals, limits and the uptime guarantee
Independent reviews | Technoa5bar (plans read 12 October 2026), HowToHosting (24 June 2026) and HostAdvice (8 May 2026), plus TechRadar's Domain.com review
Independent tests | We looked for a documented speed or uptime test with a stated method and found none, so we make no speed claims
Our calculations | The three-year cost table is our own arithmetic from Domain.com's prices
When sources disagree | We show both views. For prices and the uptime guarantee we use Domain.com's own page
Freshness | Prices and offers are read again before this page goes live
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test
